title: ZPK Digital ID Gemma 4 Good Demo Package
subtitle: Android-first identity registration and recovery demo, video, evidence, and submission files
description: ZPK Digital ID is a local-first Android identity wallet for Guatemalan citizens. This dataset contains the demo ZIP, final narrated video, writeup, evidence, and reproducibility files for the Gemma 4 Good Hackathon submission. It uses synthetic data only and includes no API keys.

resources.description: Downloadable demo package with APK, static demo page, final video, evidence, screenshots, and Unsloth scaffold.
SHA-256 checksum for the downloadable demo package.
1600x900 cover image for the Kaggle media gallery.
Copy/paste Kaggle submission fields and prize-claim guidance.
